notes.title: Gifts for everyone!
notes.content:
Hello!
As you may notice, the time of the year is here.
Knowing how good were you this year, I prepared little gifts for you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32196329/cd8664474aa02bc6e9e872ef980bfbf64f2cb5ef.png[/img]
From [b]21st December[/b], an in-game event will start.
You will have the possibility to unlock special character items. To unlock them, you will need to find the required amount of gifts. Each level contains a different amount of collectible gifts, and all you need to do is pick it up ːsteamhappyː
[h3]You don't need to complete the level to count the gift as collected! 
If you collected it, you can exit and equip the unlocked item![/h3]

Besides the in-game event, I also updated the Steam version with all the latest bug fixes from console versions. And if you check the character customization screen, you will notice that there are extra items available!

Oh, and a new feature was added:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32196329/199241acb987afd2ab95e34f5ae6665a217b66ae.jpg[/img]
When you open the tasks menu, you will see how many special/event items are available.

There is one more gift for you!
I added two cheat codes, and they can be activated just like in the old days by pressing key combinations.
One unlocks all levels and the other activates the gift event faster. The cheat codes can be found at my discord pined messages >> [url=https://discord.gg/DEvxfKF]SimDevs Discord[/url]

[h3]I wish you all Happy Holidays, and see you in 2021![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32196329/fd31390a0314348ad6396333fd34643f98759016.png[/img]

[i][b]P.S.[/b] All these changes are also available on [b]Xbox[/b] and [b]Nintendo Switch[/b][/i] ːearthishː

notes.title: Status Update #2
notes.content:
Hello, space escapers!

After a bit of silence, I'm back with a status update and news about what will happen next with [b]Area 86[/b]!

Let's start with the "silence" period.
Trus me, it was not silent at all. As you would notice,[b] Area 86[/b] is available on [b]Steam[/b] for [b]Win/OSX/Linux[/b].
And as you would guess, it would be worth trying to get [b]Area 86[/b] on other platforms like Xbox One and Nintendo Switch.
So I worked like crazy on getting [b]Area 86[/b] on other platforms, and must admit, it was harder than first thought.
But I did it and [b]Area 86[/b] right now is available on Xbox One, and it will be available on Nintendo Switch on November 11th.

Now that the porting to other platforms is completed I returned to the [b]Steam[/b] version.
Checked how many people have [b]supported me[/b] ( [i]bought[/i] ) and decided to put [b]Area 86[/b] on a side for now. If you ask why, the reason is simple.
The player ( [i][b]supporters[/b][/i] ) amount did not reach my goal.

Don't get me wrong, I'm happy, and I'm very thankful for every player ( [i][b]supporter[/b][/i] ) that [b]Area 86[/b] received and continues to receive!
Also, there is hope that one day [b]Area 86[/b] will reach my player goal on [b]Steam[/b] and I will surprise you all with new content. ːsteamhappyː
( [i]The hope comes from the data that [b]Area 86[/b] is on more than [b]4k[/b] potential player wishlist.[/i] )

With all this said, for now, I will move a bit away from [b]Area 86[/b] and try to create something else.
Your more than welcome to give a hint/idea/input on what should or could I create next.

Thank you!

notes.title: Status Update!
notes.content:
Hello!
Long time nothing posted, so I thought of writing a status update!

We all humans, and we need to recharge our powers!
So I took time off from working on Area 86 and tried to relax.

Now I'm returning and looking at what to do next!

Have some changes in mind, like remove the chapters menu.
The reason is that it's not needed anymore. At the beginning of the development, I had a little story in mind, but it was pointless as I'm not the right person for such a task. So I'm getting rid of it.
The new levels will get added to the current level list, and everything will be fine! Maybe I could add some extra features to the level screen - hmm?

I also started to work on character customization!
Probably will write more about it in the next time as right now need to create more items, so it's fun to use and show off!

And one more thing. Thinking of changing Area 86 price as many users point that it's too expensive for the current ~3h playthrough.


Till next time!

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Let's talk about the last patch.ːsteamhappyː

I transferred the whole project from [b]Unity 2018.4[/b] to [b]Unity 2019.3[/b].
As expected, things went south and received a decent amount of new bugs.
Most of the bugs are fixed & the latest version should work better than the previous versions.
[b]And no more visual glitches while you play![/b]
[i]( This was the main reason why made the upgrade )[/i]

Also, the main initiator for screen glitches where ropes and tapes.
I removed all of them and replaced them with a different solution.
Should look and work better than before.

Some buttons were missing interactions with other objects.
Added missing components & now you can activate them by throwing any object at them.

There were places in levels where your robot could get stuck because of static colliders. 
Not any more! At least, fixed the reported spots.

Found and fixed a possible game start crash that was happening for some users.
And finally, updated some localization values.

After this big update continuing to work on new levels and probably will write in the next development blog, how's it going.


Thank you for your support and feedback!

notes.title: Devblog #18
notes.content:
I hope you're doing well and staying safe! ːearthishː

Development of Area 86 has slowed down a bit in March, but I'm back and pushing forward!

The release day is coming closer and closer, uhh! 
Not sure if ready for release, panic!
But I have promised to deliver on [b]April 15th[/b] and let's keep it that way! ːsteamhappyː

So what's done for the release:

[h3]Localization[/h3][b]Area 86[/b] is available in [b]12[/b] different languages including Latvian.
Big thanks to people who helped localize [b]Area 86[/b] to different languages.

and others...

[h3]Steam Features[/h3]Thanks to the Facepunch Steamwork plugin, the implementation of Steam features did not create much trouble.
Added achievements ( [i]still adding right now[/i] ), Implemented cloud saves and tested how controllers behave ( [i]so far so good[/i] )
Still have plans of implementing other features, but that's after release!
[b]P.S.[/b] Achievements are localized too!

[h3]Levels[/h3]The 1st chapter is almost done!
Almost because the last [b]6th[/b] level is still in development. ːsteamsadː
It has missing visuals, but the functional part is [b]90%[/b] completed.
Considering that it should not take too much time to add the visual part, because the 6th level is at the same size as the 1st level! [b]Fingers crossed![/b]

[h3]Press[/h3]Started reaching out to media ( [i]Youtubers, Twitch & Mixer streamers[/i] )
Not sure what to expect from this as it's my 1st experience reaching them.
But I think it's better to try than not try at all - right? 
[b]P.S.S.[/b] If you know anybody who would like to write, stream or make a video about [b]Area 86[/b] - let me know!


Thanks for reading and see you soon in [b]Area 86[/b]! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Devblog #17
notes.content:
Let's start with the most exciting news!

I decided to release [b]Area 86[/b] on [b]April 15th[/b] ːsteamhappyː
[i]( no matter what will happen )[/i]

The release version is still in heavy development, and no time should be wasted! ːcleanhourglassː
Have a release todo list which looks like:
[list]
[*]Last level development ( where you will need to defeat a corrupted AI system )
[*]Localization ( some strings missing )
[*]Achievements
[*]More polishing
[*]Robot customization? ( 50/50 chance that will make it on release, if not will come 100% in next updates )
[/list]

The first release version will contain the full first chapter!
In this chapter, you will have the possibility to complete more than 50 different tasks, puzzles, and challenges.
Including other robot saving and working together, if you decide to do so.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32196329/566a7bdf1e77ae7bc23ad1e78acf9cfde75a67c0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32196329/566a7bdf1e77ae7bc23ad1e78acf9cfde75a67c0.png[/img][/url]
Of course, work will not stop after release, and more interesting features are waiting in the line of development. Like chapter 2 with more levels and cooperative gameplay!

Also thinking about how to improve [b]Area 86[/b] visibility and one of the options would be to release a proper demo version.
[i]( It would be awesome to release it before the release version - right? )[/i]

Let's talk about the new level that was added to the list.
As always, it contains breakable items, parkour, hidden secrets, and 10 tasks/puzzles to complete.
Also, there is a possibility to save another robot that is stuck in an ice cube. The new robot is bigger, heavier but slower. But don't think the robot is useless! It can become very handy by destroying objects or smashing shortcuts in walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32196329/749cbbd1450d7dcabb415789d3835ccdf4045a41.gif[/img]

Let's take a look at how the level has evolved from the last dev blog:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32196329/de1da4de3a27738367a7e6bdb920e0bd064aa469.jpg[/img]
[i]( The storage room received more items and hidden messages )[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32196329/2809db7d1b6800fe0ee1ce942051a57058b7ec56.jpg[/img]
[i]( Who does write on walls in a space station? )[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32196329/f1c211115321d051d947377dafe873006ce0d1ff.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32196329/4733360dbcbe63eed6e95174f7f7dd7d402c66be.jpg[/img]

OK, the release date is coming, need to get back to work.
Till next time!

notes.title: Devblog #14
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Halloween![/h1]

[b]Area 86[/b] did not release in this year's 2019 October, but still, I wanted to create a pumpkin and put it on our robot!
With this said, character customization is official.
[i]( For now, it's just a pumpkin on the head with a button in options to enable it ːsteamfacepalmː )[/i]

What else did happen in October?
Oh - right - I got some great news to share!

Submitted Area 86 to a contest called [b]Baltic Sea Games Award[/b].
There are 4 possible nominees in this contest:
“Best Game Design”, “Best Game Art”, “Best Game Audio” and “Best Game Narrative”.

Can you guess what [b]Area 86[/b] did in this contest?
Before you answer, I must say that I was surprised when received the mail.
[b]Area 86[/b] did win [b]Best Game Design[/b] ːsteamhappyː
OMG - I was happy and proud of my work.
As a winner, I need to prepare for the award ceremony which will take place at GameOn on 16 November 2019.

But it does not end there!
The contest has 2nd phase and now there is a possibility to online vote for a favorite game from the finalists.
The online vote can be found here:
[url=https://www.ahk-balt.org/veranstaltungen/baltic-sea-games-award/]Baltic Sea Games Award info and Vote![/url]
( don't want to push anybody, but a vote for Area 86 would be great ːcleanfloppyː)

Apart from preparing for the event and preparing stuff for contests.
I did progress in [b]Level 5[/b] ːsteamhappyː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32196329/ab92cf7ea94a1f79a4bd2b42d46c45890ed6d3ac.png[/img]
[i]It still requires work on the visual side, but I just wanted to share the progress of it.[/i]

After playing around with visual effects, I decided to add Post-Processing to Area 86.
It does make look [b]Area 86[/b] better, but if it hits your performance, there is a possibility to disable it in options!

Not sure if anybody will notice, but added a little feature to our robot.
When the robot jumps and falls back, it bounces back a bit from the ground.
Such a little simple feature - but get all the little things together and you get a decent game.
[i]( at least that's what I think )[/i]

That's it for now and I hope you're ready for November?

notes.title: Devblog #8
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32196329/e7d236b01fe0a8031c012659f4b6f7336f0e0be4.jpg[/img]
Welcome back in the year 2019!
January is already over and did not share any work progress about [b]Area 86[/b]

Must say, that January was a pretty progressive month!
[i][ maybe the cold weather helps? ][/i]
Started creating a new level and added some interesting features.
One of them is a flying [b]drone[/b]!!!
[i][ was a bit challenging but at the same time funny ][/i]
Be aware that this drone will not be your friend!
Because the main goal for the drone is to keep the assigned room clean from unauthorized objects, including your robot.
But don't think that you can't use it for your needs ːsteamhappyː
There is always some choices - will you destroy it, will you ride on it or maybe you can outrun it? 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32196329/5bb903ca585d35278be11b5fdd8d7a3cd9b9f8c7.gif[/img]

Also made some improvements/polishing to previous levels and added some new features:
- When you make the choice to save another robot, when saved, it will try help you get further in the active level. You will notice a speech bubble above the robot and it will include the required item which is required to help and proceed further!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32196329/7b4f79008fff597415d6e75fea3598b522ec4a1d.gif[/img]

- Added new universal "save spot" icon for robot saving.
If you see this icon, you know where to transfer your saved robot!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32196329/f4bfbf49fdaec4d9c7873cb53b45615f1dc5558b.jpg[/img]

- Added little tutorial hint on how to operate other robots and improved robot friendship/trust factor visualization!
[i][ robots don't trust each other on the fly, you will need to gain the trust! ][/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32196329/a5e820998845c4a4c8a95230ebfbcdc96c2cffbc.png[/img]

- Improved some previous puzzles by adding more visual hints and making them easier to complete!

And that's it for now!

[i][b]P.S.[/b] Spread the word about Area 86[/i]
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Devblog #2
notes.content:
Look at that - it's already May!
Is time speeding up or is it just me?

Don't feel that did so much in April, but if we look back at it - it was something!
One of the biggest achievements was showing off [b]Area 86[/b] at GameDev Days Estonia.
Meet many interesting people and watched with big interest how people interact with [b]Area 86![/b]
Here comes the summary:
[list]
    [*]Recieved pretty positive feedback!
    [*]One person managed to stuck so bad with the robot, that it did not want to move at all. Thanks to him - the bug is fixed now :)
    [*]From all the players only ~3 did not like it. And the reasons was that it's too hard for them!
At least they tried.
[*] Some people got super excited already at first steps.
[*] Some did pick the controller without any hope that they will like it. 
But after playing it for more than ~1min. They changed their opinion and where impressed!
[*]Feedback from players - pure gold!
[/list]

The magic controller that did survive all the madness!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32196329/6cfe83554c39ca87392803ed23a90c60bed3d932.jpg[/img]

Overall - very happy that did showoff Area 86 at the event and meet interesting people!
As it comes, after such events you feel very exhausted.ːsteamboredː
So the work on Area 86 slowed down.

Little bug fixes here and there but nothing impressive!
But wait till the weekend started - power was back and work continued with a new twist.

Did some impressive fixes and feature improvements. 
Global overview of the changelog:
[list]
[*]Massively improved item picking up!
[*]You can finally pick/throw chairs :D
[*]Small item throwing should be more controlled
[*]Fixed wall button interaction
[*]Fixed not jumping/stuck player bug
[*]Fixed glass not breaking bug
[*]Improved Level 2 [ lighter box top, nonbreakable window visual ]
[*]Improved physics stability
[*]Reduced robot smashing volume when hitting with max speed
[/list]

How will you use the [b]chair?[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32196329/a2e253e6bc15636e0b79f1f648404c3bf8dca79e.png[/img]

P.S. Did I mention that [b]Björn[/b] did an awesome game critique?
You can check it out at:
https://www.twitch.tv/videos/252116818?t=02h02m40s
